title: Provider pricing override layer for dsh-model-pricing
description: Per-provider (billing-channel) pricing over the model base table. Lets the same model be billed differently per channel — e.g. a subscription channel that does not meter tokens per-call (billing: subscription) vs. a metered API. A record priced as (provider, model) first looks up its provider here, then falls back to the model base table.

version.description: Bump when pricing semantics change; consumers re-fetch on change.

currency.description: All amounts are RMB per million tokens (metered rows).

usdExchangeRate.description: RMB per USD, for display of USD-denominated plans.

provider.description: Provider route key as recorded in the ledger (e.g. deepseek-official, opencode-go, commandcode, zai, staryears).

model.description: Exact model string as recorded under this provider (may carry a provider prefix, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash).

billing.description: metered: billed per million tokens at the rates below (or the base table). subscription: included in a subscription/plan — no per-token charge to record.

rate.description: Optional metered rates that override the model base table for this (provider, model). Required when billing=metered and the channel's price differs from the base table.

note.description: Human note (terms reference, caveat, date checked).
